guide.yeti.title: Yeti Cwothes
guide.yeti.text:
Wawm fuw cwothes fow the snyow. They wowk fow Wink and fow Winkwe, who gets hew own vewsion. **How to get them:** on **Snyowpeak**, tawk to **Ashei**. The fiwst time you tawk to hew she gives you hew sketch. Wight aftew that she tewws you it's pwetty cowd up thewe and hands you the **Yeti Cwothes**. YAwweady met Ashei on Snyowpeak befowe? Then you simpwy have them once you woad youw save. **Weawing them:** pick them in the Cowwection scween nyext to youw othew cwothes, ow on the **Tunyics** page of Quick Access. **Options** (**Menyus** tab, Cowwection Scween):
**Show Yeti Cwothes**: on by defauwt. Tuwnyed off, they awe hidden, but you stiww get them.
**Yeti Textuwes**: with **Onwy Cwothes**, the fwosty wook fow swowd, shiewd, bow, face and haiw onwy shows on Snyowpeak and in Snyowpeak Wuins. **Evewything** shows it evewywhewe.
guide.ordon_hero.title: Owdon Hewo
guide.ordon_hero.text:
A thank-you fwom the peopwe of Owdon fow keeping the chiwdwen safe. Whiwe you weaw the cwothes, **Eponya wuns 15% fastew**. Winkwe gets hew own vewsion, the **Owdon Hewoinye** cwothes.

**Fiwst:** tuwn on **Show Owdon Hewo** (**Menyus** tab, Cowwection Scween). It is off by defauwt, and without it thewe is nyo quest.

**1. Wagon escowt:** the quest stawts once Tewma's wagon has made it to Kakawiko. Fwom then on the chiwdwen awe safe thewe.

**2. The wettew:** the postman bwings you "Come Home to Owdon!". He onwy shows up in **Hywuwe Fiewd**: wawk into onye of the open aweas thewe and he comes wunnying. You don't have to wait fow him, you can go to Owdon wight away.

**3. Bo:** tawk to Bo in Owdon duwing the day. Wink tewws him the chiwdwen awe safe, and Bo asks you to teww the othews.

**4. The viwwagews:** tawk to each of them once, in anyy owdew:
- **Hanch** and **Jaggwe**: outside in the viwwage
- **Uwi**: in hew house
- **Pewgie**: in Jaggwe's house
- **Sewa**: in hew shop
- **Fado**: at the wanch
Bo awways tewws you who stiww doesn't knyow.

**5. Back to Bo:** once evewyonye knyows, he gives you the cwothes.

The cwothes awe in the Cowwection scween nyext to youw othew cwothes. **Owdon Hewo cap** gives them Wink's cap ow Winkwe's hood.
guide.reinforced_shield.title: Weinfowced Shiewd
guide.reinforced_shield.text:
Jaggwe puts metaw on youw Owdon Shiewd. It **nyevew buwns**, and with the hidden skiww **Shiewd Attack** most enyemies **faww uvw**. In wetuwn you take **25% mowe damage**, and heavy hits bweak youw guawd.

Nyeeds **Show Owdon Hewo** as weww.

**1. Gowon Minyes:** once you have cweawed them, Jaggwe sends you the wettew "Bwing Me Youw Shiewd!". You can awso just go and tawk to him.

**2. Jaggwe:** tawk to him outside in Owdon duwing the day and give him youw **Owdon Shiewd**. If you don't have it anyymowe (fow exampwe because it buwnyed), he makes a nyew onye fow **100 Wupees**.

**3. Wait onye in-game day:** that's 24 in-game houws, about 16 to 17 weaw minyutes. The cwock onwy wuns outside, wike in Hywuwe Fiewd, Fawon Woods, Wake Hywia ow Castwe Town. It stands stiww in Owdon, Kakawiko, indoows, in dungeons and duwing cutscenyes.

**4. Pick it up:** Jaggwe sends you "Youw Shiewd's Weady!", but you don't nyeed the wettew. Tawk to him and you get the shiewd, awweady equipped.

**Shiewd Attack:** Bokobwins, Buwbwins, Wizawfos, Dynyawfos and manyy othews faww uvw. Bosses and enyemies that can't faww (wike Dawknyuts ow Stawfos) get the nyowmaw shiewd attack, so the Hewm Spwittew stiww wowks on them.
guide.flurry_rush.title: Fwuwwy Wush
guide.flurry_rush.text:
Dodge an attack at the vewy wast moment and time swows down, so you can stwike again and again. **How it wowks:** wock on to an enyemy with {btn:L}. Just befowe its attack hits you, push the stick sideways ow back and pwess {btn:A} to side hop ow backfwip. If youw timing was wight, evewything swows down. Nyow hit {btn:B} as fast as you can. **Unwocking** (**Combat** tab, Fwuwwy Wush, **Unwock**):
**Weawn as hidden skiww** (defauwt): fiwst weawn aww seven hidden skiwws fwom the Hewo's Shade. Midnya then feews something stiwwing in the **Sacwed Gwuv**: a gowden wowf waits whewe the Tempwe of Time once stood, and the Hewo's Shade teaches you Fwuwwy Wush as the eighth hidden skiww.
**Awways avaiwabwe**: you can use it wight away. **Pewfect dodge window**: how manyy fwames aftew the dodge stiww count as pewfect. Wowew is hawdew.
**Fowget Fwuwwy Wush**: wesets the skiww on this save, so you can weawn it again.
guide.bullet_time.title: Buwwet Time
guide.bullet_time.text:
Aim the bow in mid-aiw and time swows down. **Combat** tab, **Buwwet Time**.

**How:** jump ow faww fwom a high pwace, wike a cwiff ow a taww wedge. A smaww hop is nyot enyough. Whiwe you awe in the aiw, dwaw the bow (bomb awwows and the Hawkeye wowk too). The wowwd swows down, but Wink and his awwows keep theiw fuww speed, so you have time to winye up youw shot.

**It ends** when you wand, stop aiming, pwess {btn:A} ow wun out of staminya.

With **Staminya** tuwnyed on, Buwwet Time dwains the metew: a fuww metew wasts about 10 seconds. Without it, it wasts untiw you wand.
guide.stamina.title: Staminya and Spwint
guide.stamina.text:
A staminya metew fow fights, cwimbing and swimming. **Staminya & Spwint** tab.

**What uses staminya:** swowd attacks, hidden skiwws, jump and spin attacks, wowws, side hops and backfwips, bwocking, cwimbing, hanging on wedges, swimming and aiming with items wike the bow. Pick what counts in **Choose Staminya Activities** and how much each onye costs in **Set Staminya Costs**.

**Spwint:** howd {btn:SPWINT} whiwe wunnying. This awso wowks as a wowf and whiwe swimming (nyot with the Zowa Awmow). In the **Contwows** tab, **Spwint mode** wets you tap instead of howd.

**Out of staminya:** Wink is exhausted and can't attack, woww ow spwint untiw the metew has wefiwwed a bit. Bwocking with an empty metew bweaks youw guawd. With **Dwown when out of staminya**, wunnying out whiwe swimming costs you a heawt.

**Mowe staminya:** with **Scawe max staminya with max heawts**, evewy nyew heawt containyew gives you mowe staminya.

The metew can be a baw in the HUD ow a wheew nyext to Wink (**Customization** tab, Staminya Baw, Stywe).
guide.zora.title: Zowa Swimming
guide.zora.text:
Two hewpews fow the **Zowa Awmow**, both in the **Quawity of Wife** tab. **Auto Zowa Awmow:** Wink puts on the Zowa Awmow as soon as he swims and switches back to his owd cwothes on wand. You nyeed to own the Zowa Awmow.
**On**: onwy whiwe swimming.
**On + shawwow watew**: awso when you wade thwough shawwow watew.
**On + shawwow watew, both feet**: the waised foot gets it too. **Impwuvd Zowa Swimming:** with the Zowa Awmow undew watew, just steew with the stick, nyo button nyeeded. Tap {btn:A} fow a speed buwst with a bawwew woww, howd {btn:A} to swim fast. Wink weans into tuwns and weaves a twaiw of bubbwes.
guide.quick_access.title: Quick Access
guide.quick_access.text:
Use items and bottwes without openying the item wheew. **Quick Access** tab. **Tap** {btn:QA} to use youw quick item.
**Howd** {btn:QA} to open the menyu. Point the stick at a swot and wet go: that item becomes youw nyew quick item. **Pages:** besides youw items thewe is a page fow youw **Bottwes** ({btn:LB}) and onye fow youw **Tunyics**. Othew mods can add theiw own pages. **Choosing items:** pwess {btn:X} in the menyu to pick which items go on the swots. **As a wowf**, howding {btn:QA} opens a wheew with **Wawp** and the **Sun's Song**. **Settings:** the button is in the **Contwows** tab (Quick Access button), the wook in the **Customization** tab: **Wadiaw** wike the item wheew, ow **Item Baw (BotW-stywe)** at the top of the scween. **Hide items fwom item wheew** takes youw quick items out of the nyowmaw item wheew.
guide.z_button.title: Z Button
guide.z_button.text:
A thiwd item swot on {btn:Z}, nyext to {btn:X} and {btn:Y}. **Quawity of Wife** tab, **Enyabwe thiwd item swot**. **Putting an item on Z:** open the item wheew, point at an item and pwess {btn:Z}, just wike you do with {btn:X} and {btn:Y}. **Midnya** gets hew own button, the **Midnya button** in the **Contwows** tab:
{btn:LB}: Midnya's icon sits at the top weft, {btn:DPAD_LEFT} toggwes the minyimap.
{btn:DPAD_LEFT}: caww Midnya with the D-Pad.
{btn:R} + {btn:DPAD_RIGHT} toggwes the minyimap in both cases. Twiwight HD and Wazy Tweaks have theiw own thiwd swot. The settings teww you what to do when onye of them is instawwed.
guide.map_markers.title: Map Mawkews
guide.map_markers.text:
Pwace youw own mawkews on the map. **Menyus** tab, **Map Mawkews**. **On the map:** pwess {btn:Y} to pwace a mawkew ow to wemuv the onye undew the cuwsow. Pwess {btn:X} to choose its symbow and cowow. **Beacon:** mawkews with the Beacon symbow show up as **wight beams** in the wowwd and on a **compass** at the top of the scween, so you awways knyow whewe to go. **Mowe options:**
**Show on minyimap**: youw mawkews awso show on the minyimap.
**Wemuv when weached**: a mawkew disappeaws once Wink gets thewe.
**Wemuv aww mawkews**: cweaws evewy mawkew of this save. Mawkews awe stowed with youw save fiwe.
guide.photo_mode.title: Photo Mode
guide.photo_mode.text:
Fweeze the game and take pictuwes. **Genyewaw** tab, Camewa, **Photo mode**.

Pwess {btn:PHOTO} to open and cwose it. The wowwd stops and you can fwy the camewa awound fweewy.

YIn its menyu you can change the **time of day** and the **weathew**, add **depth of fiewd**, **fiwtews** wike Bwack and White ow Gowden Houw, **pawticwes** wike weaves, petaws and fiwefwies, and **fwames**. You can awso hide Wink fow scenyewy shots.

**Twack** wecowds smooth camewa fwights awong waypoints. **Pwesets** saves youw favowite setups.

The hints at the bottom show which button takes the photo, hides the menyu ow cwoses photo mode. The photo mode button can be changed in the **Contwows** tab.
guide.boss_rush.title: Boss Wush
guide.boss_rush.text:
Fight anyy boss of the game again, as often as you wike. Spoiwew wawnying: you can weach bosses you haven't met in the stowy yet. **Stawting:** pick **Boss Wush** as the game mode in Duskwight's stawt menyu. You wand in the Boss Wush chambew, a haww fuww of boss statues. Midnya expwains evewything the fiwst time. **Fighting:** wawk up to a statue and pwess {btn:A}. Whiwe you stand thewe, set up youw items in the item wheew and the statue wemembews them. At Zant's statue, {btn:DPAD_LEFT_WIGHT} picks onye of his six phases. **Mastew Wush:** the Mastew Swowd stawts evewy boss back to back, timed as onye wun. **Modes** (caww Midnya in the chambew):
**Nyowmaw**: evewything awwowed, times awe onwy saved wocawwy.
**Gwitchwess**: onwy the geaw Wink nyowmawwy has at each boss.
**Gwitched**: aww items.
Gwitchwess and Gwitched tuwn off aww Twiwit Essentiaws featuwes, cheats and othew mods, so evewy wun is faiw. **Wetwy:** the **Wetwy button** (**Contwows** tab) westawts the cuwwent fight. Caww Midnya duwing a fight to go back to the chambew. **Weadewboawd:** tuwn on the **Onwinye weadewboawd** and set a **Pwayew nyame** in the **Onwinye** tab befowe you fight. Caww Midnya in the chambew to see the Top 10.
guide.cave.title: Cave of Owdeaws
guide.cave.text:
A timed wun thwough the **Cave of Owdeaws**, with its own weadewboawd.

**Stawting:** in the Boss Wush chambew, stand undew the beww and pwess {btn:A} (**Stawt Cave**).

YYou fight thwough the fwoows onye aftew anyothew against the cwock. The fwoows with the faiwies awe skipped. Just wike the boss fights, youw times count fow the onwinye weadewboawd in Gwitchwess and Gwitched mode.

With **Show Spwits** on, a spwit wist compawes you to youw best wun.
guide.online.title: Onwinye Pway
guide.online.text:
Pway the Boss Wush and the Dungeon Wush togethew with othew pwayews uvw the intewnyet.

**Tuwnying it on:** in the **Onwinye** tab, tuwn on the **Onwinye weadewboawd**, set a **Pwayew nyame** and tuwn on **Awwow onwinye**. You then see the othew pwayews in the Boss Wush chambew and in the Dungeon Wush hub.

**Pawty:** invite pwayews in the **Pawty** tab of the mod settings. In a pawty you fight bosses togethew: when someonye stawts a fight, the othews can join by pwessing {btn:A} in the chambew. In the Dungeon Wush, **Pawty mode** decides if you pway **Togethew** (items, keys and pwogwess awe shawed) ow **Against each othew** (the othews awe onwy ghosts).

**Duew:** chawwenge anyothew pwayew to a PvP fight in the **Duew** tab. Whoevew chawwenges picks the awenya.

**Chat:** pwess Entew to open the chat, Tab switches between evewyonye and youw pawty. With **Voice chat** you can tawk using youw micwophonye.

Times you set whiwe you awe in a pawty awe nyot upwoaded to the weadewboawd.
guide.dungeon_rush.title: Dungeon Wush
guide.dungeon_rush.text:
Pway thwough the game's dungeons fwom a centwaw hub, with a timew and spwits. Contains spoiwews fow the whowe game. **Stawting:** pick **Dungeon Wush** as the game mode in Duskwight's stawt menyu. You wand in a hub with a wing of doows, and Midnya expwains it the fiwst time. **A wun:** each doow weads to a dungeon. Wawk thwough onye to stawt at that dungeon's entwance. A wun is awways the whowe dungeon, the timew stops when the boss fawws. **At a doow:**
set up youw items in the item wheew, the doow wemembews them.
{btn:Y} shows the spwits: pewsonyaw best, best segments and Sum of Best.
{btn:X} changes youw stawting woadout, edits youw spwits and upwoads them to the website. **Modes** (caww Midnya): **Nyowmaw** awwows evewything. **Gwitchwess** gives you onwy the geaw and heawts Wink nyowmawwy has when entewing the dungeon. **Gwitched** unwocks evewy item. The mode is shawed with the Boss Wush. **Inside a dungeon:** caww Midnya to go back to the hub, ow pwess the **Wetwy button** to stawt uvw fwom the entwance.
